verdicts.title: A 3D Human Body Blockage Model for Outdoor Millimeter-Wave Cellular Communication
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Blocking is one of the most important challenges in exploiting millimeter-wave for fifth-generation (5G) cellular communication systems. Compared to blockages caused by buildings or terrains, human body blockage exhibits a higher complexity due to the mobility and dynamic statistics of humans.
